Release v1.0.12
Seller application upgrades: add your birthday and gender, required business documents (DTI, BIR, permit), store tags, and pick your store location on a map
We now email you the approval or rejection decision to your Gmail — if you don't see it, check your spam folder
New congratulations screen when your application is approved — welcome to the CUFMAI family, with a one-tap Go to dashboard button
Admins can permanently delete accounts, review full seller applications with documents, and reject with a reason you'll receive by email
Merged front door: one full-bleed video hero screen for Create account + Sign in (replaces the old login and role-choice screens)
Seller application upgrades: choose your government ID type first, store front photo (becomes your store banner) + 5 product photos required at submission
In-app notification the moment an admin approves your seller application
Redesigned Application submitted screen: what-happens-next timeline, What we received checklist, and a Back to home button to browse while you wait
Developer mode (swipe gesture) for testing the flows — removed before release
